questions.questionHtml:
Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

A. “Well, then I know just the place for you,” he said.

B. “Yes,” he replied. “Do you want one in the city?”

C. “Can you suggest a good hotel?” I asked the taxi driver.

D. “No, I would prefer a quiet place.”
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CBDA'.

Key Points

  • Sentence C is independent of any other sentence as it is introducing a conversation between a man and a taxi driver.
  • In sentence is C, a question is asked by the man, and its answer is given in sentence B by the taxi driver. Hence, 'B' follows 'C'.
  • The question asked by the taxi driver in sentence B is answered by the man in sentence D. Hence, 'D' follows 'B'.
  • Sentence A ends the conversation. Hence, A is the last sentence.


Important Points

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the paragraph and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences of the paragraph (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants. Identify the pronouns connecting the sentences with each other.

B. He took another portion because he was a partner, and yet another because he was the strongest.

C. He took the last portion because an accident would befall anyone who laid a paw upon it.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'DABC.'

Key Points

  • The sentence 'D' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "a lion and other animals went hunting". Hence, 'D' is the first part.
  • Sentence A will come after D as it is giving information about what the lion said while taking one portion of the food or spoils.
  • Sentence B will come after A as it is giving information about what the lion said while taking the other two portions of the food or spoils.
  • The sentence 'C' is the concluding part because it explains what the lion said while taking the last portion of the food or spoils.
     

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences: Once a lion went hunting with three other beasts. When it was time to divide the spoils, the lion took one portion for his title as king of the forest. He took another portion because he was a partner, and yet another because he was the strongest. He took the last portion because an accident would befall anyone who laid a paw upon it.

Hint

  • Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles:
    • Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
    • Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
    • Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
       

Hinglish

  • वाक्य 'D' किसी अन्य वाक्य से स्वतंत्र है क्योंकि यह "एक शेर और अन्य जानवर शिकार करने गए" के बारे में सामान्य जानकारी दे रहा है। अतः 'D' पहला भाग है।
  • वाक्य A, D के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह इस बात की जानकारी दे रहा है कि शेर ने भोजन का एक भाग लेते समय या लूटते समय क्या कहा।
  • वाक्य B, A के बाद आएगा क्योंकि यह इस बारे में जानकारी दे रहा है कि शेर ने भोजन के अन्य दो हिस्से लेते समय या लूटते समय क्या कहा।
  • वाक्य 'C' समापन भाग है क्योंकि यह बताता है कि शेर ने भोजन के अंतिम भाग को लेते समय या लूटते समय क्या कहा।

  • Thus, the sequence becomes:

    • D: So, the first thing you need to do is to contact your bank.
    • A: Notify your card issuer that your card is missing and that it should be blocked.
    • B: Lastly, don’t forget to check your account for any unauthorised withdrawals.

A. That abandoned house is the childhood home of the director Achal Misra, who recreates it in this semi-autobiographical film.

B. It is spread over three decades.

C. ‘Gamak Ghar’ is a unique movie telling the story of a home.

D. These are from 1998 to 2019, wherein the film observes the house age as it is gradually abandoned.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'CBDA'.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is an example of a Para Jumble.
  • We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
  • Sentence C in the given question is the starting of an incident and an independent general statement. It talks about a unique movie telling the story of a home.
  • Sentence B will be the next sentence because it is further telling about the story.
  • Sentence D will be the next sentence because it is connected with Sentence B. It tells about which three decades is Sentence B talking about.
  • Lastly, Sentence A will be used because it is connected with Sentence D.
  • Thus, the sequence becomes:
    • C: 'Gamak Ghar' is a unique movie telling the story of a home.
    • B: It is spread over three decades.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BADC'.

Key Points

  • While carefully reading all the statements carefully we can conclude that sentence B is the introductory statement.
  • Sentence B will come first because it is introducing us to the fact that Palampur village has around 450 families belonging to different castes and creeds.
  • Sentence A will come second because it is talking about the main activity of the people of Palampur which is farming.
  • Sentence D is in continuation with sentence A because the use of 'other activities' in sentence D is indicating that apart from farming (mentioned in sentence A) they are also involved in dairy, transport, small-scale industries, etc.
  • Sentence C will come last because it is talking about the road connectivity of the village.
  • Therefore, the correct order is 'BADC'.
  • Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

 

The correct arrangement: Palampur village has around 450 families which belong to different castes and creeds. The main activity of Palampur is farming and 80 families of the upper caste own the majority of land in Palampur. There are other activities in Palampur like dairy, transport, small-scale manufacturing, etc. which also help run the economy in the village. The neighboring towns of the village are well connected and all-weather roads are also well connected.

Additional Information

  • 'Majority' means the greater number.
    • Example: In the majority of cases all will go smoothly.
  • 'Creed' means faith. 
    • Example: People of many creeds and cultures.

  • वाक्य D वाक्य A के क्रम में है क्योंकि वाक्य D में 'other activities' का प्रयोग यह दर्शाता है कि खेती के अलावा (वाक्य A में उल्लिखित) वे डेयरी, परिवहन, लघु उद्योग आदि में भी शामिल हैं।
  • वाक्य C सबसे अंत में आएगा क्योंकि यह गांव की सड़क संपर्क के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
  • अतः सही व्यवस्था 'BADC' है।
  • अतः विकल्प 2 सही उत्तर है।
  • 'Majority' का अर्थ है 'बहुमत'।
    • उदाहरण: In the majority of cases all will go smoothly.
  • 'Creed' का अर्थ है धार्मिक पंथ।
    • उदाहरण: People of many creeds and cultures.
